name: Black Sea
genZNote: The Black Sea only gets to the rest of the world's oceans through one exit — the Bosporus — which makes that one strait a genuine geopolitical chokepoint.

sections.heading: 🌊 Location & Ocean Connection
bullets: An almost entirely enclosed sea between south-eastern Europe and western Asia (the Caucasus/Anatolia).
Its only outlet to the world's oceans is through the Bosporus strait into the Sea of Marmara, then the Dardanelles strait into the Mediterranean.

sections.heading: 🗺️ Countries Bordering It
bullets: Turkey, Bulgaria, Romania, Ukraine, Russia, and Georgia.

sections.heading: 🚢 Ports & Trade Routes
bullets: Major ports: Constanta (Romania), Odesa (Ukraine), Novorossiysk (Russia), Istanbul (on the Bosporus, technically at the Black Sea's exit).
A key export route for grain from Ukraine and Russia, and for oil moving from Russian and Caucasus pipelines to world markets.
Because it has only one exit, Black Sea shipping is entirely dependent on safe passage through the Bosporus.

sections.heading: 🐠 Economic & Ecological Significance
bullets: Has a distinctive layered water structure — oxygen-rich surface water sits above a much larger, oxygen-free (anoxic) deep layer, one of the largest anoxic basins in the world.
Supports significant fisheries in its surface waters, though these have been affected by pollution and invasive species over past decades.
A major route for both grain and energy exports makes it strategically significant well beyond its size.

quickRevision.oneLineDefinition: The Black Sea is an almost fully enclosed sea between south-eastern Europe and western Asia, reaching world oceans only via the Bosporus and Dardanelles.
keyFacts: Borders Turkey, Bulgaria, Romania, Ukraine, Russia, Georgia.
Only exit to open ocean: Bosporus → Sea of Marmara → Dardanelles → Mediterranean.
Major grain and oil export route.
Has a large anoxic (oxygen-free) deep-water layer.
commonConfusion: The Black Sea's only sea outlet is the Bosporus — it does not connect directly to the Caspian Sea, which is a separate, landlocked body of water.

highYieldFacts: Black Sea's only ocean access: Bosporus → Marmara → Dardanelles → Mediterranean.
Has one of the world's largest anoxic (oxygen-free) deep-water zones.
commonTraps: Don't confuse the Black Sea with the Caspian Sea — the Caspian is fully landlocked with no ocean outlet at all.
mustRemember: Black Sea = enclosed sea, single exit via the Bosporus, major grain/energy export route.
